name: Warsong Scout Update
summary: Kadrak's orders reach Warsong Scout Update as scouts watch the contested woods. The Horde relies on their reports to guard its positions in Ashenvale from night elf attacks.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: Kadrak relies on scattered Warsong scouts to watch Ashenvale's border. Night elf sentinels use the forest for cover, and the scouts risk being cut off. Couriers carry written updates between them, keeping isolated outposts connected to Horde command and able to report what they see.

sections.title: Holding the Ground
sections.body: Warsong scouts watch for night elf raids meant to reclaim the forest. The clan has paid in lives for every stretch of Ashenvale it cleared or occupied. Kadrak's orders keep forward scouts in touch with the Horde and let them report whether their defenses are holding against elven resistance.

faq.answer: Kadrak commands Horde forces along the boundary between the Barrens and Ashenvale. He coordinates scouting, border defense, and supplies for Warsong operations in the forest.

faq.q: Why are the Warsong scouts so paranoid about night elves?
faq.answer: Night elves know how to hide in their ancestral forests and surprise Horde patrols. The Warsong Clan clears lumber and settles land the elves consider sacred, leaving its scouts open to sudden attack.

faq.q: Why is Ashenvale being fought over?
faq.answer: The Horde needs Ashenvale's lumber and other resources to build Orgrimmar and supply settlements in the Barrens and Durotar. The night elves consider the forest sacred and fight to drive out the orcish loggers and garrisons.

faq.q: What is the Warsong Clan's role here?
faq.answer: The Warsong Clan leads the Horde's effort to claim Ashenvale's resources. Grom Hellscream led them into the woods during the Third War. They remain entrenched, running lumber camps and fighting the Sentinels.

faq.q: Where does this report go after reaching the scout?
faq.answer: After receiving Kadrak's instructions, the scout reports local success against elven counterattacks. This keeps Horde leaders informed about conditions at the front.

faq.q: Are the Horde's plans in Ashenvale succeeding at this point?
faq.answer: The frontline scouts believe their defenses are holding. They keep their fortified positions and fend off elven attacks, but Ashenvale remains fiercely contested and neither side has full control.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you help secure its Ashenvale foothold by carrying Kadrak's orders to the outer scouts, who face night elf ambushes.
As an orc, you inherit the Warsong Clan's fight for Ashenvale's timber, against the land and its ancient defenders.
As a night elf, you see Warsong scouts on the borders as a continuing desecration of Elune's sacred forests. The Sentinels strive to drive them out.
